title: Tempo
description: Tempo 3.1 single binary (pod tempo-0, local filesystem, 7-day retention): span ingestion, live-store, backend scheduler/worker (compaction + retention), queries and resources. Curated from the official tempo-mixin (https://github.com/grafana/tempo/tree/main/operations/tempo-mixin: tempo-writes, tempo-reads, tempo-operational, tempo-resources and its alerts) keeping only metrics a Tempo v3 single binary exports (no ingester/compactor/memcached/Kafka consumer/gateway metrics).

list.name: Firing alerts
list.expr: ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"Tempo.*"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing", namespace="monitoring", pod=~"tempo-[0-9]+"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing", job="tempo"}
list.textFormat: Prometheus ALERTS series in state firing. See Alertmanager / alert rules for details.

list.name: Container restarts
list.textFormat: kube-state-metrics saw the restart counter change (crash, OOMKill or liveness failure).

list.name: Overrides reloaded
list.textFormat: The per-tenant overrides file was reloaded with a new hash.

options.content:
**Tempo** stores traces. Its only writer is the `otel-gateway` (OTLP gRPC to `tempo:4317`); Grafana reads
it (Explore, trace links from logs/metrics) and the Tempo MCP server is exposed at `/api/mcp`. Tempo v3 single
binary runs distributor -> live-store (recent traces, in memory + local WAL) -> block-builder (writes blocks) and a
backend-scheduler/worker pair that compacts blocks and applies retention. The metrics generator is **off** (span
metrics and the service graph come from the otel-gateway instead).

**Healthy**: Up, live-store ready, spans refused/discarded 0, no failed completions/flushes, compaction and
retention errors 0, query 5xx 0.

**Expected noise**: the backend-worker polls the scheduler and gets `NotFound: no jobs found` when there is nothing
to compact: those requests show up as `/tempopb.BackendScheduler/Next status=error` and worker call retries. They are
filtered out of the error panels here and are harmless while the retry rate stays under the mixin threshold (5/min).

**Empty panels**: span ingestion panels stay empty until an application sends traces (today no workload exports
OTLP traces: OBI only instruments `staffops*` namespaces). Logs: `kubectl --context k8s01 -n monitoring logs tempo-0`.

Formulas: [tempo-mixin](https://github.com/grafana/tempo/tree/main/operations/tempo-mixin).

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Scrape health of Tempo (`up`).

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Running version (`tempo_build_info`).

panels.title: Live-store ready
panels.description: `tempo_live_store_ready`: 1 when the live-store finished replaying its WAL / catching up and serves recent traces.

panels.title: Spans accepted / s
panels.description: Spans accepted by Tempo's OTLP receiver (`tempo_receiver_accepted_spans`, mixin tempo-writes 'Spans / sec'). Empty/No data = no traces were ever received since the last restart.

panels.title: Refused + discarded (1h)
panels.description: Spans refused by the receiver (`tempo_receiver_refused_spans`) plus spans discarded by the distributor (`tempo_discarded_spans_total`: rate limited, trace too large, live traces limit) in the last hour. Any value = lost traces.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(tempo_receiver_refused_spans{job="tempo", namespace="monitoring"}[1h])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(tempo_discarded_spans_total{job="tempo", namespace="monitoring"}[1h])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Overrides OK
panels.description: `tempo_runtime_config_last_reload_successful`: the per-tenant overrides file loaded. Mixin alert TempoBadOverrides fires when 0 for 15m.

panels.title: Live-store unhealthy
panels.description: Ring members of the live-store in state Unhealthy (`tempo_ring_members{name="live-store", state="Unhealthy"}`). Mixin alert TempoLiveStoreUnhealthy fires when > 0 for 15m.

panels.title: Node disk used
panels.description: Root filesystem of the node, where local-path keeps the Tempo volume (no per-volume stats for hostPath PVs). Shared with Loki and Prometheus.

panels.title: Restarts (24h)
panels.description: Container restarts of tempo in the last 24h (kube-state-metrics).

panels.title: Receiver spans / s
panels.description: Spans accepted and refused by the OTLP receiver per receiver/transport (mixin tempo-writes 'Receiver spans / sec': `tempo_receiver_accepted_spans`, `tempo_receiver_refused_spans`). Refused = Tempo pushed back (limits, overload); the otel-gateway retries and its queue grows. Empty until the first trace arrives.

panels.title: Distributor received
panels.description: Spans and bytes received by the distributor per tenant (mixin tempo-writes 'Bytes / sec': `tempo_distributor_spans_received_total`, `tempo_distributor_bytes_received_total`). Compare bytes/s with the ingestion rate limit (30 MB/s default). Empty until the first trace arrives.

panels.title: Discarded spans by reason
panels.description: Spans dropped by the distributor, by reason (mixin tempo-writes 'Discarded spans': `tempo_discarded_spans_total`): rate_limited, trace_too_large, live_traces_exceeded... Empty = nothing discarded.

panels.title: Traces per push / write latency
panels.description: Average traces per received batch (`tempo_distributor_traces_per_batch`) and average distributor write latency to the ingest queue (`tempo_distributor_kafka_write_latency_seconds`, mixin tempo-writes 'Kafka write latency'; there is no external Kafka in this single binary, the series is exported anyway). Empty/0 while nothing is ingested.

panels.title: Inflight requests / TCP connections
panels.description: Requests in flight per route (`tempo_inflight_requests`) and open connections vs limit (`tempo_tcp_connections`). `/frontend.Frontend/Process` is the long-lived querier <-> frontend stream (constant, not load).

panels.title: Completion queue / blocks completed
panels.description: Blocks waiting to be completed (`tempo_live_store_complete_queue_length`, mixin tempo-reads 'Pending Queue Length') and blocks completed per hour (`tempo_live_store_blocks_completed_total`, mixin 'Completed Blocks'). A queue that never drains = the disk cannot keep up.

panels.title: Live-store failures
panels.description: Failed block completions and local flushes, plus their retries (`tempo_live_store_failed_completions_total`, `tempo_live_store_local_failed_flushes_total`, `..._retries_total`). Failures = recent traces not persisted (disk full / corrupt WAL).

panels.title: Back-pressure / catch-up
panels.description: Time the live-store spent applying back-pressure (`tempo_live_store_back_pressure_duration_seconds`) and its catch-up duration after start (`tempo_live_store_catch_up_duration_seconds`). Back-pressure slows ingestion when the live-store is overloaded.

panels.title: Partition ring / ring members
panels.description: Single-binary rings: live-store partitions by state (`tempo_partition_ring_partitions`) and ring members by state (`tempo_ring_members`). Expected: 1 Active partition, 1 ACTIVE live-store member.

panels.title: Block builder
panels.description: Block-builder consume cycles and flushed bytes (`tempo_block_builder_consume_cycle_duration_seconds`, `tempo_block_builder_flush_size_bytes`): how often and how much it writes to the backend. Flat at 0 while nothing is ingested.

panels.title: Compaction / retention errors
panels.description: Errors compacting blocks (`tempodb_compaction_errors_total`, mixin alert TempoCompactionsFailing: > 2 in 1h) and applying retention (`tempodb_retention_errors_total`, mixin tempo-operational 'maintenance errors'). Failing compaction lets the blocklist and query cost grow.

panels.title: Retention
panels.description: Blocks marked for deletion and deleted by retention per hour (mixin tempo-operational 'retention': `tempodb_retention_marked_for_deletion_total`, `tempodb_retention_deleted_total`) and retention run duration. Starts moving once data is older than 7 days.

panels.title: Backend worker retries / work queue
panels.description: Worker -> scheduler call retries per minute (`tempo_backend_worker_call_retries_total`; mixin alert TempoBackendWorkerCallRetriesHigh above 5/min; here mostly 'no jobs found' polls) and the tempodb work queue as a share of its max (mixin tempo-operational '%age total work queue').

panels.title: Blocklist poll duration
panels.description: Average time to poll the backend for the list of blocks (`tempodb_blocklist_poll_duration_seconds`, mixin tempo-operational 'Blocklist Poll Duration'). Grows with the number of blocks; slow polls delay queries seeing new blocks.

panels.title: Backend scheduler cycles
panels.description: Compaction cycles that found no tenant work (`tempo_backend_scheduler_compaction_empty_tenant_cycle_total`) and empty jobs (`tempo_backend_scheduler_compaction_tenant_empty_job_total`, mixin alert TempoBackendSchedulerCompactionEmptyJobRateHigh above 10/min). Empty cycles are normal on an idle lab.

panels.title: Requests by route / status
panels.description: Requests per second by route and status (`tempo_request_duration_seconds_count`, mixin tempo-reads 'QPS'), without health checks, metrics scrapes, the frontend stream and the scheduler poll. Search/trace-by-ID routes appear when Grafana queries Tempo.

panels.title: Request latency p99 by route
panels.description: p99 latency per route (mixin tempo-reads 'Latency': histogram_quantile over `tempo_request_duration_seconds_bucket`), same filter as the left panel.

panels.title: Querier worker / frontend
panels.description: Requests executed by querier workers (`tempo_querier_worker_request_executed_total`) and frontend retries (`tempo_query_frontend_retries`). Retries = sub-queries failing and being re-sent.

panels.title: CPU (cores)
panels.description: CPU used by the container (cAdvisor `container_cpu_usage_seconds_total`, rate) against its request (kube-state-metrics). No CPU limit is set in this lab (requests only), so the container can burst; sustained use far above the request means the request should be raised so the scheduler accounts for it. Formula: kubernetes-mixin 'Compute Resources / Pod' dashboard.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set (what the kernel OOM-killer looks at) against the memory request and limit. The working set reaching the limit means an OOMKill (watch the restart annotation). Formula: kubernetes-mixin 'Compute Resources / Pod' dashboard (container_memory_working_set_bytes).

panels.title: Disk: node root filesystem
panels.description: The Tempo volume (WAL + blocks) is a local-path hostPath directory on this filesystem; kubelet exports no per-volume stats for it.
